title: Consensus Within, Competition Between: Decentralized LLM Teams for Perimeter Defense
abstract: arXiv:2610.41044v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The use of large language models (LLMs) to coordinate multi-agent teams raises a fundamental architectural question: whether task allocation should be centralized in a single LLM controller or distributed across autonomous LLM agents, particularly when communication is unreliable. In a deliberately simplified perimeter-defense simulation against LLM-controlled intruders, we compared a central commander, an auction-based consensus team and independent agents under five network conditions. Breach rates were 15% for the consensus team, 32% for the commander and 29% for independent agents, and of the different network conditions, only limited radio range changed a team's breach rate, raising the commander's. In consensus team, giving a low-cost LLM more authority over the bid computation raised breaches by 38 percentage points. translated_title: 内部共识，相互竞争：用于周界防御的去中心化LLM团队
translated_abstract: 使用大语言模型（LLM）来协调多智能体团队引发了一个根本性的架构问题：任务分配应该集中在一个单一的LLM控制器中，还是应该分布在多个自主的LLM智能体之间，尤其是在通信不可靠的情况下。在一个特意简化的、对抗LLM控制入侵者的周界防御模拟中，我们比较了中央指挥官、基于拍卖的共识团队和独立智能体在五种网络条件下的表现。共识团队的突破率为15%，中央指挥官为32%，独立智能体为29%；而在各种网络条件中，只有无线电范围的限制改变了一支团队的突破率，即提高了中央指挥官的突破率。在共识团队中，让低成本LLM在出价计算中拥有更多权限会使突破率提高38个百分点。考虑到空域中的鸟类和民用无人机，我们在输入文本状态中为每类对象添加了一张照片。只有近（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 在周界防御模拟中，基于拍卖共识的去中心化LLM团队（突破率15%）优于中央指挥官（32%）和独立智能体（29%），并对网络条件表现出最强的鲁棒性，但让低成本LLM参与出价计算会显著恶化防御效果。
en_tdlr: In a perimeter-defense simulation, a decentralized auction-based consensus LLM team outperformed both a central commander and independent agents (15% vs. 32% and 29% breach rates) and was most robust to network conditions, though granting a low-cost LLM more authority over bid computation increased breaches by 38 percentage points.
